answer: An identity locks a 200-credit vault bond funded only by earned payouts in a sable record. Each payout funds one bond only. At the canyon checkpoint an auditor traces the bond to earned work; a purchased or reused bond is rejected and burned. Earning 200 credits takes 10 tasks at 20 credits each, so one fake costs 10 tasks plus the lock. The k-th fake needs 10 fresh tasks and a fresh bond, so 1,000 fakes cost 10,000 tasks and 200,000 credits locked. Injection fails: a transferred bond has no earned payout and burns. One honest agent earns one bond and keeps it.
